title: choices.v1
description: Answers the student can tap under the question the tutor has just asked, on a screen with a conversation. Tapping one is the student's turn, exactly as if they had typed its words: the screen sends them as a typed message, which passes the same gates. With multiple, the student marks several and sends them together, joined by commas, as one turn.

options.description: What each button says, which is also what tapping it sends. A word, a number or a few words.

multiple.description: true lets the student mark several before sending them, for a question such as «marca todas las que…». Left out, one tap answers.
